name: BLOOM
description:
Here is how to read the BLOOM config.json. The architecture class is BloomForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

num_hidden_layers is 70: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

vocab_size is 250,880. 250,880 is divisible by 256, the usual vocab-tiling grain. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/bigscience/bloom/blob/main/config.json.
